heading: Tokens
llmTokenUsagePushedFromThe: LLM token usage, pushed from the
nothingPushedYetTheAgentHasnT: Nothing pushed yet. The agent hasn't reported any usage.
countedFromLocalSessionLogsDeduplicatedP: . Counted from local session logs, deduplicated per response, and archived so the total survives the logs being pruned.
cacheReadsAreAlmostAllOfIt: Cache reads are almost all of it. That's the point of the cache. Re-sending a long conversation costs a tenth of reading it fresh.
whatThisUsageWouldHaveCostOn: What this usage would have cost on the API at list price. Input and output are priced per model, cache reads at a tenth of the input rate, and cache writes at 1.25× or 2× depending on how long they live. It is
thisRunsOnASubscriptionSoNone: : this runs on a subscription, so none of it was charged per token.
tokensCameFromModelsWithNoRate: {p0} tokens came from models with no rate in the table and are left out of this figure.
copilotVsCodeTotalsAreEstimatesFrom: Some tool totals are estimated from visible local session history because hidden system prompts and tool results are not stored locally.
countsOnlyNoPromptsNoFilePaths: Counts only. No prompts, no file paths, no project names.
